SELECT 
    hostplname,
    (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::real as mass_val,
    (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::real as radius_val,
    CASE 
        WHEN (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::real IS NOT NULL 
             AND (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::real IS NOT NULL
             AND (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::real > 0
        THEN (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::real / ((4.0/3.0) * 3.14159265358979 * POWER((stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::real, 3))
        ELSE NULL
    END as density
FROM stars
WHERE (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::real IS NOT NULL
  AND (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::real IS NOT NULL
  AND (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::real > 0
ORDER BY density DESC
